newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Kohl swims on Australia's Barrier Reef.
newsitem.headline: Kohl swims on Australia's Barrier Reef.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl went swimming on Australia's Great Barrier Reef on Saturday, taking a first-hand look at one of the world's natural wonders on the second day of a five-day visit to the country.

During a weekend off before talks with Australian political leaders in Canberra on Monday, Kohl also took a ride in a glass-bottomed boat to admire the famed reef's plentiful fish and colourful coral.
Australian officials have been hoping to use Kohl's visit to encourage tourism from Germany -- Germans spend more per head in Australia than any other foreign visitors.

But Kohl has insisted that his weekend in tropical Queensland state remain a private affair and photographers have been kept away from Kohl's leisure activities -- including Saturday's outing to the Reef.
